description: This file defines the Address interface which specifies the standard address fields used in the OpenMRS project. It includes getter and setter methods for various address components such as address lines, city, state, postal code, country, geographic coordinates, and additional address fields introduced in version 2.0.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: An interface representing the standard structure for an address in OpenMRS, with methods to get and set various address-related fields.
